versions.content: Existence of TlsCryptoCipherSuite . certificate and TlsCryptoCipherSuite . pskIdentity in the client role The client ( TlsCryp- toServiceMapping has the attribute category set to the value TLS_CLIENT ) has the following authentication options: • the reference to CryptoServiceCertificate in the role TlsCryptoCi- pherSuite . certificate exists, • the aggregation of TlsPskIdentity in the role TlsCryptoCipherSuite . pskIdentity exists, • neither one or the other exists.
